title: Phase transition in optimal hypercontractivity
summary: We discover an exponent-dependent phase transition phenomenon for optimal hypercontractivity: for every prescribed $q_0>2$, there exists a reversible continuous-time Markov chain on three state space with normalized spectral gap whose $(2,q)$-optimal hypercontractivity time satisfies $$ \text{$t_{\mathrm{opt}}(2,q)=\frac12\log(q-1)$ if and only if $q\ge q_0$},$$ whereas the strict inequality $t_{\mathrm{opt}}(2,q)>\frac12\log(q-1)$ holds for $2<q<q_0$.
